purpose: Build a balanced mock SAP Lead session from the existing assessment case sets without creating a second case database.

short_session.rule: Select one case from each assessment track. Prefer Diagnose, Design, or Challenge unless a lower reasoning level is currently weak.

extended_session.rule: Cover every assessment track at least twice, include at least three cross-process cases, and keep at least half of the session at Diagnose, Design, or Challenge level.

selection_order: exclude recently answered cases where the pool allows it
prefer weak tracks and weak dimensions from local history
avoid duplicate titles and near-identical scenarios
shuffle only among equally suitable candidates
session_rules: Do not reveal expected points before the user chooses to review the answer.
Score every answered case with the same seven dimensions used by the Practice Engine.
Persist scored attempts to the shared local attempt history so mock sessions improve adaptive selection later.
A skipped case does not count as a scored attempt.
A session summary must show track coverage, reasoning-level coverage, average score, Lead-level attempts, weakest dimensions, and recommended review routes.
The browser page must work without a backend and must not send local notes or scores to a server.
completion_rule: A mock session is complete when all selected cases are answered or explicitly skipped and the user has a summary that points to the next review action.
